text: In 1950s Magdalena, Corazon, [shunned by the villagers as a rumoured wartime prostitute|wrong|the outsider punished], longs for a child with her devoted husband Daniel. A faith healer's advice brings a pregnancy, but [the baby is stillborn|origin|grief that will not end], and the loss drives her mad: she [kills and devours village children by night|wants|feeding on the living] and vanishes, feral, into the forest. Daniel refuses to believe it, while the abusive landlord Matias [turns the villagers against them|threat|the powerful and their systems].
